updates.title: CVE-2026-105590 Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A certificate validation flaw in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass security features over the network. Admins should prioritize patching systems running AD CS to prevent potential issuance of unauthorized certificates.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148 Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services was identified and updated with corrected information. Organizations should review and apply security updates to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680 Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM authentication was updated to include Microsoft Office software in the affected products list. Admins managing identity and authentication systems should ensure Office installations are patched to protect against NTLM-based attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082 Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial of service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos authentication was updated with clarifying information. Organizations should apply available patches to prevent attackers from disrupting authentication services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling SharePoint Library Default Labels
updates.summary: Organizations will be able to automatically apply default sensitivity labels configured on SharePoint document libraries to existing files at rest, eliminating manual labeling gaps and enforcing consistent data protection across libraries. This reduces administrative overhead while ensuring compliance-ready default labeling across all SharePoint content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync Status SLA Reduction
updates.summary: The Purview UI will display Endpoint DLP policy sync status updates within 30 minutes instead of the previous 2-hour window, providing admins faster visibility into policy deployment across endpoints. This improvement enables quicker identification and resolution of policy synchronization issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance Alert Customization
updates.summary: Admins will gain granular control over Communication Compliance alerting, including per-policy frequency settings and customizable email alert recipients and cadence during policy creation. This flexibility allows organizations to tune compliance notifications to their operational needs and reduce alert fatigue.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Server-Side Auto-labeling for Legacy Office Formats
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will now support legacy Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt), enabling automatic sensitivity label application to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive. This extends labeling coverage to older file formats that may still exist in many organizations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5 TB limitation, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable storage for E5-licensed customers. This removes a previous operational constraint that could cause mailboxes to become inoperative when reaching storage limits.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Reports
updates.summary: Admins can now view detailed coverage metrics for each auto-labeling policy, showing labeled file volumes, unlabeled files, and discrepancies between simulation and actual enforcement runs. These reports help track policy effectiveness and identify gaps in coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery Premium Hold Reports for Government Clouds
updates.summary: Government cloud tenants will gain out-of-the-box reporting for all legal holds in eDiscovery cases, with sorting, filtering, and export capabilities for compliance and audit purposes. This improves visibility into hold status and simplifies compliance documentation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Enable Version Trimming Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Authorized Purview RBAC admins will be able to enable file version cleanup in SharePoint and OneDrive even when retention policies are active, reducing storage bloat while maintaining compliance and legal-hold integrity. This policy-scoped setting allows organizations to reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Network Security Broad Website Scoping
updates.summary: Admins will be able to scope Purview network data security DLP policies integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access to target all websites or all websites except specific cloud apps, extending protection beyond the Defender Cloud App Catalog. This provides broader flexibility in applying DLP controls to web traffic.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Automated Deletion of Inactive Departed Employee Mailboxes and OneDrives
updates.summary: Admins will be able to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale through Purview, automating compliance-required cleanups without manual intervention. This capability streamlines offboarding processes and ensures tenant data hygiene for regulatory compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Microsoft Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) are now accessible via Microsoft Graph API, providing a unified view of archive data before EWS APIs deprecate in October 2026. This enables developers and admins to programmatically access and manage archive data across multiple mailboxes seamlessly.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols and can apply restrictive actions based on organizational policies, closing a gap in legacy file transfer protocol coverage. Admins can configure FTP/SFTP transfer activities in existing Endpoint DLP policies.
